title: 109. How to use tokens to create a link?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How to use tokens to create a link.
short_answer: In order to create a list of tokens (authentication tokens) that can be distributed to access a secured online questionnaire, open your survey and go to the 'Participants' page. Click on 'Create new guest list' to start a wizard that will guide you through the process. Choose a name for the group and select 'Token list' from the types of guest lists.
procedure: Use the created tokens to build up individual access links you can send per emails to the participants using the URL below:
SurveyAlias with the alias of your survey TOKEN with one of the tokens from the token list
